original_visible_content.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist realizes before renewal that required CE hours are missing and looks for the notice method described in the currently posted CE policy.

Case B: After notifying the Massachusetts Board about missing hours, the pharmacist assumes the deficiency has been waived without a Board decision.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The current policy directs the pharmacist to email a detailed explanatory statement to the Board.
Sending the explanatory email automatically waives the remaining hours.
The CE email instruction abolishes all mandatory-disclosure requirements.
A pharmacist may attest to compliance once a future CE course has been booked.

choice_analysis.A: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 현재 Policy 2021-04의 통지는 상세 사유 statement를 Board에 email하는 방식이다.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. email 발송과 waiver 승인·요건 충족은 별개다.
교정된 설명: Sending an explanation does not itself waive the missing CE requirement.
choice_analysis.C:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 이 교정은 CE 통지 방식에 한정되며 다른 보고 의무를 폐지하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: The CE notice method does not eliminate unrelated mandatory-disclosure duties.
choice_analysis.D:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 미래 강의 예약은 현재의 미충족을 충족으로 바꾸지 않는다.
교정된 설명: A renewal attestation must accurately reflect compliance rather than conceal a known deficiency.
